threads.body: Because this module replaces and imports `tools/go`, its dependency graph includes the versions declared by `tools/go/go.mod`. This hunk updates the core OTel module to v1.46.0 but leaves all three OTLP exporter modules at v1.45.0, while `tools/go` now requires them at v1.46.0; `scenarios/http/go/go.sum` likewise has no v1.46.0 exporter checksums. A clean build will therefore either rewrite the lock files or fail with `-mod=readonly` (the same stale graph also remains for grpc-gateway/genproto/grpc elsewhere in this file). Regenerate this module's go.mod and go.sum after the shared-module update.
